settings.name: SKETCHFORGE_PORT
settings.validation: Compose host port published to container port 3000; configure this when host port 3000 is already occupied.

settings.name: SKETCHFORGE_SHARED_PROJECTS_VOLUME
settings.validation: Docker named volume or bind mount source for /data/projects, where shared project files are stored.

settings.name: SKETCHFORGE_PROJECTS_VOLUME
settings.validation: Docker named volume or bind mount source for /data/my-projects. Used when SKETCHFORGE_PROJECTS_DIR points to that path.

settings.name: PORT
settings.validation: Integer from 1 through 65535; invalid values fall back to 3000.

settings.name: HOSTNAME
settings.default: 0.0.0.0 in the Docker launcher; otherwise supplied by the hosting runtime.
settings.validation: Passed to the Next.js server as its bind host.

settings.name: SKETCHFORGE_LEGACY_PORT
settings.validation: Integer from 1 through 65535; invalid values fall back to 80. Set equal to PORT to disable the compatibility proxy.

settings.name: SKETCHFORGE_PROJECTS_DIR
settings.validation: Filesystem path writable by the server. Enables server-backed project storage and must be paired with SKETCHFORGE_API_TOKEN to enable the scripting REST API.
settings.subsystem: Server project storage and REST API

settings.name: SKETCHFORGE_API_TOKEN
settings.default: Unset; REST API authorization is disabled.
settings.validation: Non-empty bearer token. Configure a high-entropy secret; never expose it to browsers or logs. Used with SKETCHFORGE_PROJECTS_DIR.

settings.name: SKETCHFORGE_SHARED_PROJECTS_DIR
settings.default: /data/projects in the Docker image and compose examples.
settings.validation: Filesystem path writable by the server; mount persistent storage at this path to retain shared projects across container replacement.

settings.name: SKETCHFORGE_APP_VERSION
settings.default: Detected from the installed package or project metadata.
settings.validation: Semantic version; invalid values are ignored.

settings.name: SKETCHFORGE_UPDATE_MANIFEST_URL
settings.validation: HTTP or HTTPS URL returning JSON with a semantic-version `version` field.

settings.name: SKETCHFORGE_UPDATE_GUIDE_URL
settings.validation: URL shown to users as the update guide.

settings.name: SKETCHFORGE_UPDATE_TRIGGER_URL
settings.validation: HTTP or HTTPS URL for the configured update trigger endpoint.

settings.name: SKETCHFORGE_UPDATE_ADMIN_KEY
settings.validation: Secret expected by the update trigger service. Required with SKETCHFORGE_UPDATE_TRIGGER_URL.

settings.name: SKETCHFORGE_UPDATE_TRIGGER_TOKEN
settings.validation: Secret bearer token sent to the configured trigger endpoint. Required when that endpoint enforces a trigger token.
